_doc: How the abyss warns you as you fall (scripts/match/abyss_fx.gd danger_depth: the red tint and vignette; scripts/match/abyss_fall_sfx.gd warn_db / warn_rate: the heartbeat warning). Depths are metres under the lowest island lip around you. Nothing shows until start_depth (0.25 m, the reference's tint start), so a dip of a hand's width is free; from there the danger rises smoothly (curve = share of the way to the point of no return, to the power curve) to 1 at the kill depth (Hunter.abyss_kill_y). Rising faster than the glider lift (AbyssFx.RISE_OFF) or climbing back above start_depth lets go. audio_from: metres under the lip where the falling wind and the warning heartbeat start (the reference's audio start, 3 m; yours only). warn_*: the warning heartbeat starts at audio_from, at warn_db_min dB and warn_rate_min beats a second, and rises to warn_db_max dB and warn_rate_max at full danger. edge_from: danger where the crimson screen-edge rings start (they ramp up to full at 1).
